title: Puppy One Harness
goal: Benchmark and grade an on-device model for Puppy One without producing a number that flatters it, and record the run so model generations stay comparable.
deliverables: benchmark result with validity scored beside latency
graded review queue with every row judged
evolution ledger row including the capability profile
regression fixtures for every confirmed failure
impact_fields: Judge and whether it was a separate context
common_failures: grading in the session that wrote the queue, which remembers where the controls went
grading a corpus this session has graded before: positions move per run, the planted rows' wording does not

appending verdict lines to verdicts.jsonl with a shell redirect instead of putting the grader's JSONL through memory_judge.py replay, which voids the run for verdict_appended_past_writer; the grading lane is read-only and does not write, so the orchestrator replays

opening or hunting for the seal while grading, or reading memory_judge_controls in the harness source, which names the planted rows in clear and leaves no trace; run-manifest.json carries the declared rule vocabulary and locates no control
reporting accuracy for a run whose controls were missed instead of voiding it
comparing runs with different capability profiles, which invents a trend
